user.title: Add your No Hassle AV matrix
user.description: An HDMI matrix set up with an earlier version of this integration was found. Import it to keep its entities, history and area.

menu_options.manual: Set up a matrix by address

manual.title: Connect your HDMI matrix
manual.description: For compatible 8×8 models using HTTP video.set and all_dat.get. Setup does not switch outputs. Routing reports are checked every 15 seconds. Actual power feedback remains unknown on the tested firmware.

error.invalid_sources: Give each input a different, non-empty name.
